motion_rule: HIS BODY crosses the frame edge to edge in EVERY window, talking ones too; a moving prop alone never counts; the camera never carries a window alone; he never holds a pose; new shot size every window
character: a plump velvet mole in BLACK ROUND DARK GLASSES like a blind man's, huge pink shovel-paws, dusty, utterly serious
second_characters: ONE digger above, never a face, only a SHOVEL blade through the roof
props: CALCULATOR: cream plastic, BLANK buttons and screen. CHEST: a battered wooden trunk. BOOTS: two split boots. HAT: a crushed felt hat. TAPER STAND: old brass, wick lit
prop_continuity: the calculator never lights up; the ringing comes from the earth, not the device; the dark glasses stay on his eyes until 8.1
environment: a round burrow, roots overhead, packed soil, the lit brass taper stand on it
lighting: bright light from a hole above, dust motes lit, high exposure; the wick is a prop, not the light; gold only from 8.1

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: calm businesslike male voice, even 4.3 syllables/sec, never drawn out
audio.pacing: speech 0.6-3.4 and 4.2-6.5; voiceless 6.5-9.53; one word at 9.53, sfx keep going
audio.sfx: a shovel in soil, one iron chime under the floor at 3.6, more until the burrow rings by 6.5, the lid banging off frame, brass clattering over at 9.7
audio.music: none until 8.1, then a soft music box

timeline.a: silent. In his black round glasses he bursts out of the wall and hurls himself edge to edge, the blank calculator in one paw, the lit brass stand sliding past
he charges left to right along the burrow, his whole body crossing it, roots whipping over his back
he slams the far wall and rebounds right to left edge to edge, a sheet of soil dragged with him
he throws his weight onto the big blank button; the recoil flings him and the dead calculator edge to edge
silent. The SHOVEL stabs down through the roof at his head and he throws himself edge to edge clear of it, earth blasting. The floor rings under him
the shovel rips back out and the wall goes with it; he rides the falling soil edge to edge and swings up on a root
he loses the root and tumbles head over heels edge to edge, slamming into the far wall
silent. He digs like a machine, his body driving into the floor, earth blasting at the lens
silent. The shovel hooks the chest and rips it out of the soil; he chases it edge to edge and slams onto the lid
silent. He rips the lid up and flings it off frame; GOLD light blasts over him, his black glasses ride up onto his brow, his greedy eyes wide, inside split boots and a crushed hat
silent. He stamps into the boots, jams the hat on, wipes his nose with a dirty paw and drives edge to edge, the blank calculator up as a mirror
the brim slides over his eyes, his boot clips the brass stand and it topples, flame streaking, and he walks off down the burrow, the camera racing level so he never shrinks

must_appear: the shovel down at 3.4 and 7.3, the black round glasses from the first frame, boots and a crushed hat in the chest, the glasses riding up over greedy eyes in the gold at 8.1, the brass stand knocked over
negative_prompt: digits, cyrillic, a lit calculator screen, coins, subtitles, night, dark scene, a face above ground, a second mole, slow motion, a pivot in place, a static wide at the end, a shrinking hero, any voice between 6.5 and 9.5
